story.hero.title: Your compass
story.hero.lead: Based on what you told us about yourself, the compass points to a few good programmes. Not one answer and not a verdict: a map you can take further.
story.proof.title: Your five strengths
story.proof.note: For each one you can see where you know it from. These go into the compass.
story.dims.title: Your orientations
story.dims.text: Six kinds of activity. The longer the bar, the more often you chose those activities and situations. Your two strongest: {a} and {b}. Together with your strengths, they set the needle of the compass.
story.nne.kicker: NNE and NNW · the next two
story.nne.title: Three good paths, not one
story.nne.note: The needle wavers between them because the differences are small. You choose which one to check first.
story.ews.title: Three other views
story.most.name: Bridge: {name}
story.surprise.name: Surprise: {name}
story.surprise.text: Outside your main areas, and it still fits.
story.quick.name: Quick start: {name}
story.quick.text: First job in {years} years, and further studies stay open.
story.next.title: See each programme up close
story.next.text: Tap a name on the compass or keep scrolling: for each programme we will show the way from your strengths to studies and jobs.
story.next.short: Short on time? Jump straight to the plan.
story.dirs.title: From strengths to a job
story.dirs.lead: Choose a programme on the left. The path reads from top to bottom: your strengths, the area, studies in Kraków, example jobs.
story.route.title: Lines like trams
story.route.lead: Each programme is a line, and its stops are steps with dates. Until autumn 2027 all the lines run together, so changing lines is normal.
story.stop1.title: Matura declaration (deklaracja maturalna)
story.stop1.text: Until that day you can change your extended level (rozszerzenie) subjects. After that you cannot.
story.stop1.change: needs a change in your matura
story.stop1.ok: Your lines need no changes in the declaration.
story.stop1.link: Which extended level (rozszerzenie) opens the most? ↓
story.stop2.title: Open days (dni otwarte)
story.stop2.text: See the universities in person: {list}. One afternoon will tell you more than a website.
story.stop3.title: Matura
story.stop3.text: What universities count is mostly extended level (rozszerzenie) subjects. UJ counts only the extended level.
story.stop4.title: Admissions (rekrutacja) and enrolment
story.stop4.text: Registration on the universities' websites, usually in June and July. Post-secondary schools take enrolments in summer.
story.stop5.title: Start
story.end.title: Degree and first job
story.krakow.title: Where it is
story.krakow.lead: The universities of your programmes and the travel time from Kraków Główny station (Dworzec Główny) on an ordinary morning. Tap a point.
story.krakow.caption: Diagram to scale: the Vistula and the Main Square for orientation, no streets. Circles every 2 km from Kraków Główny station.
story.file.title: Take it with you
story.file.lead: The file holds your answers, programmes and plan. It is made on this device and is never sent anywhere. In six months you can load it and see what has changed.
story.file.cando: I can do this because… Finish it in one sentence; it goes to the top of the file.
story.parent.title: For parents
story.parent.1: Ask, don’t tell: “What surprised you here?”
story.parent.2: React to the evidence, not to the option: the evidence is your teen’s, the option can change.
story.parent.4: One small step this month, not a final choice.
story.future.hint: Choose a scenario above and you will see your programmes in its light.
story.future.forces: What matters most in this world
story.future.note: How well it fits you does not change; it is just a different light.
story.future.extra: Much needed here and a fit for you
story.future.title: What will the world look like in 10 years?
story.future.lead: Nobody knows. Choose the scenario that seems most likely to you: we will show only what matters most in it.

app.gloss.extended: A matura subject taken at the higher level. Universities usually count it more, and some (e.g. UJ) count only this level.
app.gloss.declaration: The list of subjects and levels you take at the matura. You can change it until 7 February 2027, but not after that.
app.gloss.bachelor: A first-degree course, usually 3 years. After it you can work or go on to a 2-year master's.
app.gloss.engineer: A first-degree course in a technical subject, usually 3.5 years. Then you can work or do a master's.
app.gloss.long_master: A master's course with no separate first degree, 5–6 years (e.g. psychology, physiotherapy, medicine).
app.gloss.post_secondary: A free public school after secondary school, 1–2.5 years. It ends with a technician diploma and gives you a quick start in work.
app.gloss.bridge: An option that joins your two main orientations, e.g. working with people and working with data.
app.gloss.quick: A route to a first job in 3 years or less that keeps further study open.
app.gloss.surprise: An option outside your main areas that still fits well. It is worth checking, even if it does not look like you at first glance.
app.start.results_sub: a compass with programmes in Kraków and a plan for first steps
app.start.title: What you can already do and where you will be useful
app.start.lead: About 20 minutes of questions about what you like and what you are good at. At the end you will see a few programmes in Kraków that fit you, and a plan of small first steps.
app.start.resume: You already have answers. You stopped at: {where}.
app.start.name_label: Name (optional, only for the file name)
app.start.note: There are no wrong answers. There are many good paths, and you can change your choices: this is a starting point for a conversation, not a test and not a verdict.
app.start.save_help: You can stop at any time. The Save button at the top downloads a file with your answers. Nothing is sent anywhere. To come back, load that file and you will start where you stopped.
app.certainty.direction_q: Which programme do you have in mind? We will show it first, with two neighbouring ones next to it.
app.certainty.title: How sure are you about your direction?
app.matura.title: Which subjects do you take at extended level (rozszerzenie)?
app.matura.explain: Extended level (rozszerzenie) means a matura subject taken at the higher level. It decides which programmes you can get into. Universities usually count it more, and UJ counts only this level.
app.matura.deadline: You can change your {term} until {date}. After that, you cannot.
app.where.family: at home and in the family
app.languages.title: Languages and sport
app.languages.intro: How well do you get by in each of these languages? Choose a level in each block. Languages open doors, they never close them.
app.languages.sport_q: Which sports do you do, or have you done? You can choose several.
app.languages.sport_ph: e.g. for a year, 3 times a week
app.languages.sport_note: Sport is good evidence of strengths, e.g. consistency or persistence.
app.sort.title: What you like doing
app.sort.none: you ticked nothing, and that is an answer too
app.sort.intro: Don't overthink it. It is about the activity itself, not a job. You can also swipe a card right (like) or left (dislike).
app.situations.title: What do you do when…
app.situations.none: everything skipped, and that is an answer too
app.situations.intro: Choose what you would really do, not what you think you should do.
app.style.title: How do you like to work?
app.style.intro: Slide towards the side that fits you better. The middle is fine too.
app.values.title: What matters to you at work?
app.values.intro: Choose five, in order: the most important first. {n} of 5
app.strengths.own: or describe it in one sentence
app.strengths.title: Your strengths
app.strengths.intro: Choose 5 things you are good at and tap where you see them. You don't have to write anything. {n} of 5
app.strengths.note: A strength counts when you know where it shows. It doesn't have to be anything big.
app.grow.mid: The compass is growing. Chapter {prev} is done, next up: {next}. A good moment to save your progress.
app.grow.last: The compass is growing. These are the last questions, then the results. A good moment to save your progress.
app.reveal.title: What already shows
app.reveal.lead: Your strengths and where they show:
app.reveal.maybe_note: If you see these in yourself, go back and swap one of the cards.
app.reveal.next: Now let's see where these strengths will be needed.
app.scenarios.title: The world in 10 years
app.scenarios.intro: Nobody knows how it will turn out. Here are three possible scenarios, all equally serious. Which one seems most likely to you?
app.scenarios.unknown: I don't know, any is possible
app.scenarios.note: This is a scenario, not a forecast. Your choice does not change the matching. It only shows which future need matters to you, and it goes into your file.
app.forces.title: The world in 10 years
app.forces.lead: You are studying now to be ready for a world that will look like this in 10 years. This is what you are preparing for:
app.forces.tap_hint: Work is growing here. Tap to see:
app.forces.tap_sector: Tap a sector to see which specific jobs are growing in it and why.
app.forces.match: The compass at the end will show whether any of these fits you.
app.forces.rest: Not everything fits into six sectors. These areas are also growing because of the same forces, only across many industries at once: {list}.
app.forces.closing: Fewer people to work means each person will be needed more. Let's see where your strengths will be useful.
app.cards.label_default: They match your answers in the Me chapter
app.cards.title: Where you can be useful
app.cards.intro: Of {n} areas we show the six that best match what you have already said about yourself. Tap an orientation or a strength to see others.
app.cards.intro_empty: Answer the questions in the Me chapter first, and we will show areas that match you.
app.compass.aria: The compass points north: {a}; next to it: {b} and {c}.
app.compass.title: Your compass
app.compass.lead: Three good routes, not one. Tap a direction and the compass will show where it leads.
app.reach.title: Where do you want to be needed?
app.reach.q1: Where would you like to be needed in 10 years?
app.reach.home: Where do you feel at home? (optional, you can choose several; it does not affect the results)
app.reach.note: In this version we show universities in Kraków. Other places will come later.
app.length.title: How long do you want to study?
app.length.explain: A short route, e.g. post-secondary school (szkoła policealna: 1–2.5 years, free, no matura needed) or a 3-year bachelor's (licencjat), is a fully valid option. It keeps further study open.
app.length.private_q: Are you considering private universities? They charge fees.
app.length.start_q: How many minutes does it take you to get from home to Kraków Główny station (Dworzec Główny)?
app.length.from_file: From your file: {n} min. Tap to change.
app.length.note: We use this to work out your travel time to university. It stays on this device.
app.doubt.title: What worries you most about this choice?
app.doubt.how_much: How much does it bother you?
app.reflection.title: A moment for you
app.reflection.intro: Optional. These answers are not graded. They only go into your file.
app.commute.outside: outside Kraków: {city}, you would need to move
app.threshold.text: Points threshold (próg punktowy) in {year}: the last person admitted had {points} out of {max} points{round}. This is information, not a requirement.
app.star.title: Add star
app.pay.note: Typical salary in an employed job in the “{group}” group, compared with other jobs ({src}). What you like doing counts too.
app.card.need_mine: in your scenario (“{name}”): {value}; in the others: {others}
app.card.day: What a working day looks like
app.card.blocked: They need a change in your matura choices:
app.card.private: Private universities ({n}); you chose public only
app.card.no_study: no programme in Kraków in the database
app.map.aria: Map of routes: from your strengths, through options, to programmes in Kraków. Choose an option to highlight its routes.
app.tram.aria: Lines over time: steps from today to your first job for each option. The same description is under the map as text.
app.compare.same: Same options as last time. That tells you something too.
app.compare.question: A question for yourself: what has changed for you since then?
app.preview.quick: First job after {years} years, and further studies stay open. Links to the area: {area}.
app.part.path_sub: steps with dates, and how to get there
app.part.file_sub: save it, print it, come back in six months
app.tiles.title: What do you want to see?
app.tabs.label: Parts of the results
app.pstrengths.lead: These are not test results, just your own examples. Tap a card to see the evidence and where it leads.
app.pstrengths.profile_note: The longer the bar, the more often you chose these activities and situations. The top two are your main orientations.
app.cando.title: I can do this because…
app.cando.label: Finish it in one sentence. It goes at the top of your file.
app.directions.lead: Pick an option. Read from top to bottom: your strengths lead to an area, the area to studies in Kraków, and the studies to example jobs.
app.road.needs_change: needs a change in your matura
app.fit.weak: none of your subjects is on the list
app.fit.none: needs a change in your matura
app.decl.link_tap: (tap a study programme on the road)
app.decl.basis_stars: I am counting for your stars ({n}). Add them with the ☆ next to a programme in the {link} part.
app.decl.basis_nostars: You have no stars yet, so I am counting for the programmes in your options ({total}). Mark the ones that interest you with ☆ in the {link} part, and the list will narrow.
app.decl.no_ext: You have not marked any extended-level subjects yet, so there is nothing to compare.
app.decl.sum_weak: weakly (none of your subjects is on the list)
app.decl.sum_closed: not at all (they need a change)
app.decl.none_more: No single extra extended level changes anything here. Your subjects already fit wherever one subject can make the difference.
app.decl.none: No single extra extended level changes anything here. Your subjects already fit.
app.decl.more: These need at least two new extended levels: {list}.
app.decl.indep_db: does not depend on extended levels (in the database)
app.decl.title: Matura declaration (deklaracja maturalna): what opens the most
app.decl.free: Does not depend on extended levels: {n}.
app.decl.note: This is a hint from the admissions rules in the database (mostly 2026), not a decision. Each extended level means more study, and your result counts too. Talk to your class teacher. You can change your declaration until {date}.
app.compare.indep: does not depend on extended levels
app.compare.title: Compare your stars
app.compare.one_more: Mark one more star ☆ (in “Directions” above, tap a study programme on the road) to compare them side by side.
app.compare.none: In “Directions” above, tap a study programme on the road and mark 2 or 3 with ☆. You will see them side by side here.
app.path.check_decl_ok: Check your matura declaration: your lines need no changes.
app.path.recruit: University admissions (apply online, IRK, on each university's website) or enrolment in a post-secondary school (szkoła policealna).
app.path.lead: Each option is a tram line, and its stops are steps with dates. Until autumn 2027 all lines run together, so changing lines is normal.
app.path.next_note: Tick what you have already done. It is saved only in this browser tab.
app.path.transport: Stops, lines and times from the official Kraków timetable (timetable as of {asof}): {method}, plus your trip to Kraków Główny station (Dworzec Główny). Check the route before you leave.
app.path.germany: The Polish matura gives direct entry to German universities. Most bachelor's degrees are taught in German (C1), many master's degrees in English. EU citizens do not pay tuition fees at public universities in Bavaria, only a semester fee. One possible route: a bachelor's in Kraków, a master's in Munich.
app.future.lead: Choose the scenario that seems most likely to you.
app.future.weighs: What counts most in this scenario
app.future.options_note: Most needed first. How well they fit you does not change; it is just a different light.
app.future.extra: Much needed in this scenario and a good fit for you
app.future.lead_part: Last, a game with the future. Choose a scenario: you will see only what matters most in it, and your options in that light.
app.file.lead: The file is created on this device and is never sent anywhere. In six months you load it and see what has changed.
app.doubt.help: If this worry stays with you for a long time, talk to a careers adviser at school or at a free psychological and educational counselling centre (poradnia psychologiczno-pedagogiczna).
app.parent.title: For a parent
app.parent.ask: Ask, do not tell: “What surprised you here?” works better than “See, I told you so.”
app.parent.evidence: React to the evidence, not to the option: the evidence is your child's, the option can change.
app.parent.siblings: No comparing brothers and sisters; each file belongs to its owner.
app.parent.step: Agree on one small step this month, not a final choice.
app.gate.strengths: Strengths: at least one with an example
app.gate.values: What matters to you at work
app.gate.title: Two more things
app.gate.lead: The compass needs your strengths and what matters to you. The rest sharpens it, but is not required.
app.plan.title: Not a choice. A few small steps.
app.plan.lead: You do not have to decide today. Pick one programme to check first and do a few small things. Then come back and see what has changed.
app.plan.pick: Which programme will you check first?
app.plan.not_decision: This is not a decision. In a month you can check the next one.
app.plan.done: Done: {n} of {m}. The plan is saved in your file.
app.panel.study_hint: Click a university in “Where to study in Kraków” and details appear below the road: requirements, travel, and what you can do if something is missing.
app.panel.first_job: First job after {years} years, and further studies stay open.
app.conf.head: Confidence in the results: {level}.
app.conf.low: Lower, because you skipped: {list}. You can go back and fill them in.
app.results.no_study: no programme without a change to your matura
app.results.title: Full report
app.results.intro: Everything on one page, ready to print. <button class="linkbtn" data-go="kompas">Back to the compass</button>
app.results.cutouts: Cut out the cards and put them on the table when you talk about this.
app.results.roads_note: From the left: your strengths, then the options in the middle, and specific studies on the right. Each option is its own line. A thicker line is the best match, a dashed one is a road through your interests.
app.results.pick_map: Choose where you could be useful to highlight the roads:
app.results.map_hint: Swipe sideways to see the whole map.
app.results.options_note: No numbers: each option shows why it appeared. First the three best matches, then Bridge {most}, Quick start {quick} and Surprise {surprise}.
app.results.lines_note: Each option is a tram line, and its stops are steps with dates. Shared stops are changes: until autumn 2027 all roads run together, so switching lines is normal. An orange stop means something is worth changing in your declaration before 7 February.
app.results.transport: Stops, lines and times calculated from the official Kraków timetable (GTFS, timetable as of {asof}): {method}, plus your trip to Kraków Główny station (Dworzec Główny). Lines and diversions change, so check the route before you leave.
app.results.no_times: Travel times are still being calculated.
app.results.germany: The Polish matura gives direct entry to German universities. Most bachelor's degrees are taught in German (level C1), many master's degrees in English. EU citizens do not pay tuition fees at public universities in Bavaria, only a semester fee. One possible route: a bachelor's in Kraków, a master's in Munich. Details will come in a later version.
app.doubt.help_long: If this worry stays with you for a long time, talk to a careers adviser at school or at a free psychological and educational counselling centre (poradnia psychologiczno-pedagogiczna). It is normal that a choice like this is easier with a real person, not just an app.
app.results.file_note: The file is created on this device and is never sent anywhere. You can come back to it in six months.
app.parent.if_strong: If the worry is strong: a careers adviser at school or a free psychological and educational counselling centre (poradnia psychologiczno-pedagogiczna).

gloss.title: Glossary
gloss.lead: Polish words you will meet at school and on university websites. Each one has a short explanation.
app.ukr.title: Studies linked to Ukraine
app.ukr.none_mine: None of your directions has such studies. Our Kraków data has {n} of them.
app.ukr.info: This is information, not part of your result.
app.ukr.page_lead: This page is for someone who finished school in Ukraine and wants to study in Poland. If you take the matura in Poland, everything in Kompas works as usual. This is information, not part of your result.
app.ukr.check: Rules can change. Always check the admissions page of the university you choose.
app.ukr.studies: Studies linked to Ukraine in Kraków
app.ukr.page.cert: A Ukrainian certificate of complete secondary education (atestat) issued from 20 June 2006 lets you apply for first-cycle and long-cycle master's studies in Poland.
app.ukr.page.govpl: The gov.pl page for Ukrainian citizens explains in Ukrainian how Poland recognises school and studies from Ukraine.
app.ukr.page.uek_doc: Example, UEK: with a certificate from Ukraine you do not need a separate document saying it gives the right to study. After you qualify, you must confirm the certificate is genuine (legalisation or apostille).
app.ukr.page.uek_lang: UEK also asks for a document that shows your Polish (or English, if the studies are in English). Every university has its own rules.
app.ukr.page.agh_fee: AGH: Ukrainian citizens who came to Poland from 24 February 2022 and have temporary protection (until 4 March 2027) do not pay for full-time studies in Polish.
app.ukr.page.agh_dd: AGH has double-diploma agreements with universities in Ukraine too (list on the AGH page).
app.ukr.page.matura: If you go to a Polish school: CKE has a matura exam in Ukrainian (guide valid from the 2025/2026 school year).
app.offer.page_link_aria: Programme page for {name} ({inst}) on the university website, opens in a new tab
app.src.page.title: Data sources
app.src.page.lead: Every fact in Kompas has a source. Here is the full list. Sources: {n}, marked “to check”: {check}.
app.src.page.note: Kompas does not connect to these sites while you use it: the data is saved in the app, and you can check the sources yourself. The date next to a source is the month the data is from.
